name: DF-21D Anti-Ship Ballistic Missile
description: Land-based anti-ship ballistic missile — the long arm of a coastal defence, reaching a surface group at ranges no cruise missile covers. Boosts to ~35 km, runs a depressed ballistic midcourse, then pitches into a steep terminal dive with a manoeuvring re-entry vehicle that homes on the hull. Fast and high enough that a sea-skimmer's tricks don't apply: it never hides under the radar horizon, so an Aegis ship sees it coming a long way out — but it arrives at over Mach 3 in a near-vertical dive, which is exactly the geometry point defence is worst at. Visual stand-in: Tochka-U body.
